before.name: Frits ter Kuile
before.description: Dutch Catholic Worker from Amsterdam. In summer 2018 he entered Büchel Air Base, Germany with 17 others to protest U.S. nuclear weapons deployment. He refused to pay the resulting court fine and served a 30-day sentence at Wittlich Prison in Germany beginning July 4, 2022.
